name: Estate: Dominate
source:
When your parents die in an accident, you and your sister are suddenly in a precarious financial situation. To outfit their laboratory, your parents relied heavily on loans by the Stern Group. Yet, the medical equipment they were developing is still a prototype with little financial value.

With the prospect of having to drop out of college to find work looming over you, you decide to visit Mrs. von Stern -the CEO of the Stern Group- at her office. Your only hope is for her to take pity on you and defer the loan for a few years. Instead, Mrs. von Stern offers you a deal: If you and your sister serve as household staff at her estate over the summer, the debt will be forgiven.
She only asks one thing of her servants: Total obedience. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/henissart]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
父母在一場意外中去世後，你和你的姊妹突然陷入了岌岌可危的經濟狀況。為了給實驗室配備設備，父母向施特恩集團借了一大筆錢。然而，他們研發的醫療設備仍處於原型階段，幾乎沒有經濟價值。

眼看自己可能不得不從大學退學、外出找工作，你決定到施特恩集團執行長馮．施特恩夫人的辦公室拜訪她。你唯一的希望，就是她能同情你，將還款期限推遲幾年。然而，馮．施特恩夫人卻提出了一筆交易：只要你和你的姊妹整個夏天都在她的莊園裡擔任傭人，債務便一筆勾銷。
她對傭人只有一個要求：絕對服從。
